detail.longDescription:
Main Features
📁 File Management:
● Junk Cleaner: Scan and clean junk files in your phone.
● Large file management: Identify and manage large files.
● Duplicate file management: Find and remove duplicate files.
● App management: uninstall infrequently used apps.
● Virus Scan: Detects and scans for potential viruses and malware.

📲 Photo & Media Management:
● Privacy management: Remove location data from photos.
● Photo library management: Organize your photo library.
● Similar photos management: Find similar images.
● Photo compression management: Compress photos with minimal impact on clarity.
● Media file management: Organize audio and video files.
